craft_notes: Sthāyin: Wonder at all-containing, marveled into refuge. End-dash→comma (titles soften onto filing). Rejected: 'docket' for 'code-files' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Edict thou, alpha, and omega of the cosmos, High Lord,
the code-files filed from thee: unfiled from thee, whence filed?
l4.sanskrit_cite: vidhir ādis tathānto 'si viśvasya parameśvara dharmagrāmaḥ pravṛtto yas tvatto na sa kuto bhavet

reads_against.argmap: Rule, beginning, so end you are of the world, O Supreme Lord. → You are rule, beginning, end; all dharmas are from you.
c1_essence: Law, start, close of worlds; duties march from none else.

l2.plain_english: Law and start and close of the world are you, high Lord — the host of duties marched out: unissued from you, whence could it march?
l2.sanskrit_cite: vidhir ādis tathānto 'si viśvasya parameśvara dharmagrāmaḥ pravṛtto yas tvatto na sa kuto bhavet

reads_against.t1: Rule, beginning, so end you are of the world, O Supreme Lord — the dharma-multitude set forth: which is not from you — from where would it be?
